messages:
Lara: Quick UX experiment idea: replace the tiny priority dropdown with a compact radio-like control in the rule row for the common 3-level priorities (High / Medium / Low). Prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/quickprio/radioflow
Lara: Main goals: faster scanning, clearer selected state, and better keyboard affordances. Thoughts? @Jon @Priya @Nina
Jon: Interesting. Radio approach helps discoverability but watch hit targets. Radios are small; we should render them as segmented buttons so touch target stays >=44px. Keyboard selection will be simple (arrow keys).
Priya: Copy-wise, when switching priority we should show an inline ephemeral hint: "Priority updated  Undo" rather than a toast. Keep it on the row so context isn't lost.
Nina: For equal-priority ties, we need a visible tie-breaker hint. Suggest a subtle "manual order" label and show a small reorder handle only when edit-mode is enabled. That prevents accidental drags.
Jon: A11y notes: segmented buttons should be role="tablist" with buttons role="tab"? Better to keep role="radiogroup" and role="radio" for semantics. Add aria-checked on selected option and aria-describedby linking to helper text that says "Use arrows to change priority; hold modifier to reorder."
Priya: Validation text tweak: instead of "Invalid rule" use "This rule won't match requests. Add a condition." Put that text inline under the rule title when invalid, collapsible by default.
Lara: Preview UX: rather than a global spinner we could show a skeleton line on the matched rows and animate a 3px left accent when results arrive. Faster perceived performance and less layout shift.
Nina: Spinner bug: rapid sample changes still leave spinner stuck. Engineering note: cancel in-flight request + update request id check on response to ignore stale payloads.
Jon: Keyboard reorder pattern: activate reorder mode with Space on the handle then use Up/Down. Announce changes with aria-live="polite" like "Moved rule to position 3 of 12." Include aria-grabbed while dragging.
Priya: Microcopy for empty-preview: "No matches yet. Select a sample request to preview which rules would apply." Add a small example payload dropdown.
Lara: Also consider an inline pill for preview errors: "Preview failed" with an expand chevron; links to inspector details with aria-describedby so screen readers jump.
design-bot: Contrast scan: 3 tokens low in compact-radio frame (ids: rlbl-2, rlbl-4, hint-1). Recommend label color #52565A to pass AA at 14px.
Nina: Mobile note: segmented control should stack vertically or use a single tap sheet to pick priority so we don't cram buttons on tiny screens.
Jon: Animation: when priority changes, fade the left accent from 0 -> 1 over 120ms instead of moving DOM position. Reduces reflow.
Priya: I'll draft the inline hint copy and the ephemeral "Priority updated  Undo" string; will include localization notes for short and long languages.
Lara: Action items: Priya push copy, Jon spec exact ARIA roles and keyboard reordering, Nina prototype mobile sheet + tie-breaker label, I'll update Figma and run another contrast scan. Review in 72h. :thumbsup:
